def factor_volume_amplified_mean_reversal(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    ma20 = df_copy["close"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    deviation = (ma20 - df_copy["close"]) / df_copy["close"]
    factor_vals = deviation * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_volume_amplified_mean_reversal"] = factor_vals
    return df_copy["factor_volume_amplified_mean_reversal"]
description: Mean reversion signal amplified by volume regime. When volume is above average, reversals from deviation tend to be stronger (e.g., exhaustion after high‑volume moves). Multiplying the normalized price gap by the continuous vol_ratio emphasizes signals in high‑volume regimes and dampens them in low‑volume conditions, adding nonlinear information beyond pure price deviation.
